validation.root_bracket_note: Both root brackets have simultaneous at-least-95% coverage under the model monotonicity: select the largest certified passing distance and smallest certified failing distance from the prespecified validation design. This is not a refitted point estimate.
validation.interval_note: Wilson and ordinary Clopper-Pearson are pointwise 95%. Bonferroni Clopper-Pearson intervals jointly cover the fixed validation family with at least 95% confidence, conditional on the independent fit sample. Validation points share random numbers, so their estimates are correlated. No validation-based refitting is performed.

independence.note: Independent standard-normal columns by construction. Finite-sample correlation checks (including squares) diagnose mistakes; they cannot prove independence.
